articles.title: New Owner of Longstanding Pak Mail in Lawrenceville, Georgia Brings Fresh Energy into the Business--Offering Shipping and Office Services
articles.mainIdea: New Owner of Longstanding Pak Mail in Lawrenceville, Georgia Brings Fresh Energy into the Business--Offering Shipping and Office Services
articles.summary: PR Newswire: New Owner of Longstanding Pak Mail in Lawrenceville, Georgia Brings Fresh Energy into the Business--Offering Shipping and Office Services. Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of an existing Pak Mail location in Lawrenceville, GA to new owners, Pam and Tou Yee Moua. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will benefit from the essential shipping and office services provided by this Pak Mail location for the last 31 years. Related tickers mentioned: DHLGY, UPS.
